cc:Work.dc:description: Europe/Berlin clocks include DST. A/B/C each run separately; each portfolio shares ONE position/pending-order slot. Discovery 2020–23 was inspected before portfolio selection. B contains a post-selected OR5 SHORT; these bars do not imply net profitability.
